entities.summary: Allan Vito Flores Caidic is a Filipino former professional basketball player, coach and executive who is currently serving as consultant for UE Red Warriors. He is considered by many to be the greatest shooter the country has ever produced, thus, earning the moniker, "The Triggerman".
